notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
This seemed to be due to some code related to Steam Achievements. It seems I had not disabled this functionality thoroughly and safely enough and the game was locking due to trying to connect with Steam Achievements that did not exist for the demo. I have tested this on my end and seems to be working correctly now. If anyone has any problems with this on the latest version of the demo (.03) please let me know! 

Thanks again!

notes.title: Judgment - Everything Comes Around
notes.content:
Hello!

[b]In this build the following changes and additions were made:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added some depth and texture to the player cards and scaled them up slightly. This was with the intent to make the game more fun to look at and also to make it easier to read the cards and effects at a glance

[*] Player card buff/debuff effects have new icons that are larger and more prominently displayed along the sides of cards

[*] Tooltips now appear when player card buff/debuff icons are mouse-hovered. There are also now tooltips for the Might and Exhaustion panels of the Info Scroll in combat. Right-clicking also remains as a great way to access all card info

[*] The ESC key could previously be used to skip cutscenes but this was not indicated anywhere in-game; there is now a reminder on screen during cutscenes

[*] The Space key can now be used to fast-forward through segments of cutscenes! This was by far the most requested feature by Annuit Coeptis players, and now you can hit the spacebar to zip to the next dialogue chunk in a given cutscene. Reminder for this is also displayed during cutscenes
[/list]

[b]Some minor corrections were also made, including a bugfix and adding some missing content:[/b]

[list]
[*] It is now no longer possible to play cards from the discard pile

[*] All four merchants now have the appropriate descriptive/flavor text
[/list]

Thanks again, more to come soon!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 0.24.05.22
notes.content:
Added in some features to improve the general play experience, including:

[list]
[*] Steam Cloud save capability
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] A few helpful in-game tooltips to provide a little guidance
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix
notes.content: Some users were experiencing large developer tool UI buttons on screen during combat which blocked out the End Turn button. Also reported was the inability to properly interact with cards. This was due to the scaling options for the UI being improperly set; these have been changed to correctly adjust the size of the UI panels and buttons to the screen and allow proper gameplay.

notes.title: The Storm Is Here.
notes.content:
Hello and welcome!

I am proud and excited to announce the Early Access release of Annuit Coeptis. Please feel free to post any feedback you may have - bugs, complaints, encouragement, suggestions, experiences - I'm here for it all. I am looking forward to sharing this journey with you all.

Thank you,
